# Pending wire through a shell

CadQuery keeps the circular wire in the chain for the following blind
cut. The circle on the stock's top is absent from the shell's opening
list, so the shell leaves a sealed cavity. The cut removes a radius-1
cylinder of depth 0.5 from the exterior, clear of the cavity. Its volume
is π/2 and its centroid is at z = 2.75. The cut replaces the top disk
with a disk of the same area and adds a cylindrical wall of area π.

The oracle report records the program on CadQuery 2.3.0 and OCCT 7.9.3.0.
The subset refuses the shell while the pending wire is visible.
